subject: Post-demo: Security & deployment follow-up (SOC 2, VPC/on-prem options)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jamie O'Neill <jamie@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Security & deployment follow-up (SOC 2, VPC/on-prem options)

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Call recap:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood to serve customer-facing assistance workflows across PII-sensitive pipelines.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status and evidence, GDPR & potential HIPAA scope, network isolation for inference (VPC/private vs on-prem/air-gapped), and vendor SQ kickoff.

What we can provide now:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in production for our hosted API; for Dedicated/Private we provide our SOC 2 report and guidance on controls mapping.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We have DPA + processor addendum and a HIPAA-compliant offering for customers requiring BAA (we can route to legal).
- Deployment options: hosted, dedicated VPC with private networking (customer-managed VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink), and an on-prem package that supports air-gapped installs.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll kick off the vendor security questionnaire (attached vendor-sq.xlsx) and loop in our compliance owner (Marissa).
2) Can you confirm whether Acme requires HIPAA/BAA scope?
3) If you can share a high-level desired network topology (VPC peering, transit gateway, or full on-prem air-gapped), we can prepare a tailored deployment diagram and runbook.
4) Quick follow-up call next week to review the SQ timeline and any gating procurement items.

Attachments: vendor-sq.xlsx (initial questionnaire)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
From: Jamie O'Neill <jamie@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 15:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security & deployment follow-up (SOC 2, VPC/on-prem options)

Thanks Marcus — great demo. A few quick answers and asks: 

- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report and an inventory of relevant control owners for encryption, key management, and access controls.
- HIPAA: yes, this workload will be in-scope; we will need a BAA.
- Deployment: preference is dedicated VPC first (we want network isolation and traffic never to transit public internet). Long term, on-prem air-gapped is a possibility for some regulated segments.

I'll start returning the vendor-sq.xlsx fields today — bandwidth permitting — and loop in our security lead if we need deeper architecture reviews. For the network diagram, attaching a short Acme topology doc (internal) — will send via separate secure link for Marcus/Redwood.

Can we target a 30-min follow-up next Wednesday 9th or Thursday 10th (our mornings)? Procurement may want to align on the license/commitment sizing in that call as well.

—Jamie
Jamie O'Neill
Head of Security Engineering, Acme Corp
